captions.detailed: A commercial bar blender consisting of a dark, matte-black rectangular motor housing base, a semi-transparent polycarbonate jar with a black C-shaped handle, and a hinged sound-enclosure lid. The lid is attached via a revolute hinge at the top rim of the jar, allowing it to swing open. Inside the jar sits a metallic four-blade cross assembly mounted on a continuous revolute joint at the base, while a black safety lock latch is hinged on the front face of the motor housing.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a commercial bar blender with a dark rectangular base, a clear plastic jar with a black handle, a hinged sound-enclosure lid, and a safety lock latch. Ensure the lid, the internal four-blade cross assembly, and the front safety latch are modeled with appropriate revolute and continuous joints for realistic articulation.
captions.factory: Construct the blender by first creating the main housing base as a lofted or extruded box with filleted vertical edges. Model the clear jar as a hollowed, tapered rectangular extrusion with a sweep-constructed C-shaped handle. Create the safety latch on the front face and the sound-enclosure lid at the top of the jar using box primitives, assigning them revolute joints. Finally, model the four-blade cross assembly inside the jar using intersecting cylinders/wedges and attach it to a continuous joint at the center of the jar floor.
